title: Geologic map of the Kings Mountain and Grover quadrangles, Cleveland and Gaston Counties, North Carolina, and Cherokee and York Counties, South Carolina
citation: Horton, J.W., 2006, Geologic map of the Kings Mountain and Grover quadrangles, Cleveland and Gaston Counties, North Carolina, and Cherokee and York Counties, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-2006-1238, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Kings Mountain and Grover quadrangles NC-SC (USGS OF-2006-1238, Horton 2006): pamphlet pages 2-27; units from the Description of Map Units headers (pages 19-27) with symbol, name, age and first description line; groups inferred from symbol prefixes as explained in the text. Units recorded since the text does not place them outside SC. Map face (page 1) symbols and strike/dip values not itemized; no drill-hole labels. SUBSURFACE: none. Long reference list skipped.
Continuation of the Description of Map Units (pages 28-29, lower Battleground Formation metavolcanic units) and the map plate (page 30, not itemized). SUBSURFACE: none.
